plugins.name: tableau-next-semantics
plugins.description: Pro-code toolkit for Tableau Next / Data 360: load CSVs as data streams and Data Lake Objects (with the load-time primary key), build semantic models over granular REST endpoints, wire up workspaces, and read visualizations and dashboards. Bundles eleven skills, including the tbx-* family.
